description: Read back an image saved by image::generate (its details.path or bare file name under data/provider-openai/images/) as viewable content blocks: a JPEG preview (default, fits the harness result cap) or the full bytes. Refuses any path outside that folder.

request_schema.description: Read a generated image back. Callers pass the `details.path` a generate call returned (or just its file name); anything outside `IMAGE_DATA_DIR` is refused, symlinks included, so this never becomes a general file reader. The console renderer uses it for the chat preview; an agent uses it when it needs to look at a picture it generated without `inline`.

path.description: Absolute path returned by `image::generate`, or the bare file name inside `data/provider-openai/images/`.

variant.description: `preview` (default; a JPEG at most 512px / ~80 KB that fits the harness result cap) or `full` (the saved bytes as they are).

request_schema.title: ImageReadRequest

ContentBlock.description: One block of a viewable response: an image block plus a text line — the shape the harness renders inline (same as `browser::screenshot`).

path.description: Absolute path of the file that was read.

variant.description: `preview` or `full`: what the image block carries.

PreviewDetails.description: What the inline image block actually holds when it is a preview.

content.description: `[image block, text line]` — the same viewable envelope as generate.
